subject: Charged twice for the same month
body: The invoice shows two identical charges for the monthly plan.
resolution: Refunded the duplicate charge from the billing console and enabled idempotency keys on the payment call.

subject: Refund still not received
body: A refund was approved a week ago but the card was not credited.
resolution: Card refunds take 5-10 business days; re-issued the refund to the original payment method and shared the reference number.

subject: Invoice shows the wrong tax
body: VAT is applied although we provided a valid VAT ID.
resolution: Validated the VAT ID, marked the account tax-exempt and regenerated the invoice.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: Users click reset but no email is delivered.
resolution: The email was caught by the corporate spam filter; allow-listed our sender domain and resent the link.

subject: Locked out after too many login attempts
body: The account is locked and support cannot log in either.
resolution: Unlocked the account after identity verification and turned on two-factor authentication.

subject: SSO login fails with an invalid assertion
body: SAML login redirects back with an error about the assertion signature.
resolution: The identity provider rotated its signing certificate; uploaded the new certificate to the SSO settings.

subject: API returns 503 for all requests
body: Every request to the API fails with service unavailable.
resolution: A bad deploy exhausted the connection pool; rolled back and raised the pool size with a canary.

subject: Cluster unreachable in one region
body: Applications in us-east-1 time out connecting to the database.
resolution: A network partition isolated the region; failed over to the secondary region and restored after the cloud provider fix.

subject: Background jobs stuck and not processing
body: The job queue grows and no worker picks anything up.
resolution: Workers crashed on a malformed message; quarantined the message, added a dead-letter queue and restarted the workers.

subject: How to paginate list results
body: The list endpoint returns only the first page.
resolution: Pass the next_page_token from each response into the next request until it is empty.

subject: Webhook retries flood our endpoint
body: Thousands of retries arrive after a short downtime on our side.
resolution: Enabled exponential backoff with jitter for webhook retries and capped retries at 24 hours.

subject: Export data to CSV
body: Customers want to download their records as a spreadsheet.
resolution: Use the export job with format=csv; large exports are delivered as a download link by email.

subject: Slow search results on large accounts
body: Searching takes several seconds for accounts with millions of records.
resolution: Added a compound index on account and created_at, and moved free-text search to a dedicated search index.

subject: Upgrade to annual plan was not prorated
body: Switching from monthly to annual charged the full annual price.
resolution: Applied the unused monthly balance as a credit to the annual invoice.

subject: Need to transfer ownership of the organization
body: The original owner left the company.
resolution: Verified the request with two admins and transferred ownership through the admin console.
